title: Run an initialize preflight recipe before work
narrative: Fangore starts substantive graphs only after the initialize/preflight Agentic Recipe completes linkage, capability, and checkpoint checks. Accepts WalkingLabs L06 guidance[^wl-l06-init].
implementation: Agentic Recipe `initialize_preflight` (`InitializePreflightTemplate` in `mechaharness.graph_templates.initialize_preflight`) builds linkage → capability → checkpoint → ready as an ordinary `ExecutionGraph`.
validation: Harness `cli` scenario `initialize_preflight_template.yaml`. Hard expects on declared observation keys.
